name: @omakase-robotics/ui-components
description: Shared React component library for omakase-robotics web UIs (omakaseos_service web + status_server_webui). v0.1–v0.2 status primitives, v0.3 form & layout primitives, v0.4 conversation-log primitives, v0.5 live-conversation primitives (Google Meet 1:n stage), v0.6 canonical assistant-ui primitives (Thread / Composer / MarkdownText / Tool / Reasoning / Voice — vendored from the shadcn-style assistant-ui registry, CSS Modules in-package), v0.7 AsyncCombobox (type-to-search over an async candidate list — the library's only synthetic ARIA widget, bounded by an automated boundary spec), v0.8 three vocabulary levels the shared robot console needed (--ds-text-secondary between text and muted, --ds-border-subtle below border, --ds-radius-lg above card) so a consumer no longer has to keep a private token set, v0.9 aui surface migrated off Tailwind v4 onto plain CSS Modules (same public API, no Tailwind toolchain shipped in-package), v0.10 ToggleSwitch / SignalBars / ReservedText promoted from robot-status-server-app's self-contained components/ui/ CSS modules (an SoT audit finding — three genuine L1 primitives living outside the shared design system; audio-mixer widgets deliberately left as that console's domain widgets), v0.11 the primitives the robot console still kept to itself: Spinner / Toast (three private spinner keyframes and a toast card there, another toast card on the dashboard — now presentational primitives whose timing and placement stay the host's), Panel (the titled page-grid section its 39 screens are built from, distinct from Card's surface-within-a-page), FactGrid + Fact size (the inset-tile reading of a set of facts, the missing half of the `column` direction), plus StatusBadge's opt-in `live` region, so state can be asserted by role and data-attribute instead of by its visible label.

scripts.build: bun run build:aui && bun run build:demo
